actual_scope: Four real UI entry clicks followed by independent state; research and government pages viewed. One quick-chooser wrapper attempt, proxy0 and unchanged independent research. Two QA parent failures are retained; no product whole-case promotion.
generic_lessons: Actual engine tables can be read-only even when their Lua type is table and another manager table was mutable. Detached tests do not grant writability.

Inspect every supplied replacement wrapper before requiring a lower request-layer count; an earlier guard can validly reject before that layer. Owner overlooked this wrapper and preserves the resulting assertion failure.
Capture callback return explicitly when it matters; a lambda without return discards it.
Do not retry a callback already invoked just because an observation assertion failed. Use readonly continuation.
If the native observation point is unavailable, keep native forwarding count null.
Hidden/default flags on controls outside the active rendered pane do not establish current editability.
